scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll', ''); if(fs.existsSync('UPLOAD_TO_GITHUB')){ fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'UPLOAD_TO_GITHUB/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'UPLOAD_TO_GITHUB/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('UPLOAD_TO_GITHUB/.nojekyll', ''); }"
